focus.zh: 独立完成一个功能从库表到上线、缓存/并发/索引的基本功、线上问题定位
focus.en: Owns a feature DB-to-prod; caching/concurrency/indexing; debugging

focus.zh: 端到端系统设计（可用性/一致性权衡、容灾、成本）、故障复盘、技术规范与 mentor
focus.en: End-to-end system design with trade-offs, incident review, standards and mentoring

focus.zh: 跨团队架构标准与平台演进、技术债与迁移治理、无先例架构决策
focus.en: Cross-team standards and platform evolution, migration governance, novel architecture

focus.zh: 从业务指标拆解到特征与模型、离线指标、基本的效果调优
离在线一致性、A/B 实验与效果归因、把业务目标翻译成建模目标
focus.en: Online-offline consistency, A/B and attribution, business-to-modeling objective

focus.zh: 多业务的算法策略与平台、模型与工程的系统性取舍
focus.en: Multi-business algorithm strategy and platform, model-vs-engineering trade-offs

focus.zh: 需求拆解与优先级、指标定义、把一个功能推到上线
focus.en: Requirement breakdown, prioritization, metrics, shipping a feature

focus.zh: 从模糊问题定义清晰的产品目标、跨端协作与取舍、用数据讲清价值
focus.en: Framing fuzzy problems into goals, cross-team trade-offs, data-backed value

focus.zh: 产品线策略、跨团队对齐、判断“不做什么”
focus.en: Product-line strategy, cross-team alignment, deciding what NOT to build

focus.zh: 指标体系设计、因果与实验、把分析结论变成业务决策
focus.en: Metric systems, causal inference and experiments, analysis-to-decision

focus.zh: 系统化设计与体验度量、跨端一致性、用设计推动产品决策
focus.en: Design systems and experience metrics, cross-platform consistency, design-led influence

focus.zh: 独立跑一个渠道 / 活动的投放与转化、会看漏斗复盘
focus.en: Runs a channel or campaign, reads the funnel and iterates

focus.zh: 从单点投放到搭增长 / 品牌策略、跨渠道预算分配与 ROI 负责
focus.en: From tactics to growth/brand strategy, owns budget allocation and ROI

focus.zh: 跨业务的市场策略与品牌资产、带团队做规模化增长
focus.en: Cross-business marketing strategy, brand equity, scaled growth

focus.zh: 独立走完线索到签约、讲得清打法与客户异议处理
focus.en: Owns lead-to-close, articulates the play and handles objections

focus.zh: 啃下大客户 / 复杂单、搭销售打法、管好 pipeline
focus.en: Lands key/complex accounts, builds the playbook and pipeline

focus.zh: 带团队背规模化营收、渠道与生态策略
focus.en: Leads a team to scaled revenue, channel and ecosystem strategy
